## Requirements
- R1 records connector on P04.1 writing RecordsRequest, EvidenceArtifact, released-doc captures; calls P07.1 parser.
- R2 MuckRock api_v2 + auth on all data endpoints + 5-min JWT (api_v1 wrong).
- R3 RecordsRequest runtime shape w/ §11.19 predicate surface.
- R4 no_responsive_records -> CoverageRecord (NO_EVIDENCE_FOUND) SIG-ONTO-040; name sources searched (SIG-TIME-011).
- R5 targeted-lookup discipline; no crawl SIG-INGEST-036/037.
- xcut: predicate allowlist SIG-INGEST-033; no ER SIG-INGEST-034; append-only; additive.

## ACs
- AC1 no_responsive_records writes CoverageRecord
- AC2 targeted lookups; no crawl/enumeration path
- AC3 MuckRock api_v2 + JWT; run record + quality report per capture
- AC4 released doc captured as EvidenceArtifact + linked via released_documents
- AC5 phase gate: CI green; tests; ADR; traceability + risk register

## Design
- connectors/src/connectors/records.py + data/records_vocab.toml; register in __init__.py.
- ontology already has RecordsRequest/enums/EvidenceArtifact/CoverageRecord (schema). Own runtime shape + bridge.
- coverage bridge reuses db.absence.
- MuckRock: MuckRockToken + MuckRockTokenCache(TokenSource), TTL<5min, refresh-on-401 seam (HTTP mint later ops).
- DEVIATION(ADR-034): extend connectors.net Fetcher/PoliteFetcher/Transport w/ optional per-request headers (additive).
